# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues. Use the dedicated button below:

[![https://bsicommunications.typeform.com/security-report](https://img.shields.io/badge/REPORT%20VULNERABILITY-black.svg)](https://bsicommunications.typeform.com/security-report)

After we investigate and confirm the issue, if a security fix is required, we will work towards releasing a fix asap.

## Supported Versions

This policy applies to this repository and its released versions. The following versions are currently supported with security updates:

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| 2.0.x   | Yes       |
| 1.2.x   | Yes       |
| < 1.0   | No        |


## Disclosure Policy

Please avoid public disclosure until the issue has been reviewed and a fix or mitigation is available.

## Rewards and Recognition

Given the nature of our organisation, we do not offer monetary rewards or run a paid bug bounty programme. However, we greatly appreciate the contributions that help improve the security of our projects. We are happy to publicly acknowledge individuals who responsibly report valid security vulnerabilities, with their consent, through appropriate communication channels.
